content:
maria: Pushing a batch BMC firmware update to us-west-2 GPU pool (A100) — fw 1.2.7 -> 1.3.0. Seeing ~8 nodes stuck in BMC serial console after reboot. Nodes never hand off to OS.
jay: Which nodes? can you paste node IDs and BMC logs?
maria: node-uw2-gpu-045, -052, -078, -101, -112, -130, -141, -149. Logs (from SOL) show repeatedly:
```
U-Boot 2021.04 ...
Secure Boot: enabled
Loading kernel...
Error: no valid bootable image
Drop to BMC console
```
leo: did the flash change Secure Boot flag? our process preserves flags but vendor change could toggle validation policy.
sophia: if they drop to BMC console we can try toggling secure boot to 'mixed' then re-trigger boot. Use racadm/ipmitool to check:
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc> -U admin -P $PASS sol info
racadm get BIOS.SysSecurity.SecureBoot
```
maria: tried `ipmitool chassis bootdev pxebios` and `racadm set BIOS.SysSecurity.SecureBoot Disabled` on one node — it boots to grub but kernel fails checksum. suspect new BMC enforces image validation chain (signed kernels).
jay: vendor release notes mention "enforced UEFI variable validation" in 1.3.0. Oops.
infra-oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-04-12-BMC-FW. Owners: eng-infra, eng-runtime. SLA: P2.
leo: mitigation plan:
- isolate affected nodes from scheduler (drain + disable)
- collect full SOL logs (we need signatures)
- attempt HPM reflash to 1.2.7 on a test node using OOB USB recovery or remote media if available
- if that fails, use vendor's emergency recovery cable on-site
sophia: capacity note — us-west-2 has limited spare A100 capacity. Can't evacuate all workloads to us-east without impacting latency-sensitive customers. Need to prioritize: move non-SLO batch to dedicated fallback pool (us-west-2-fallback) and failover SLO traffic to smaller models.
maria: I started a rolling disable tag on the pool; sched is evicting pods. Also opened vendor TAC ticket. They asked for BMC dump and measurement logs.
jay: For triage, add these commands to run on each affected host and paste outputs:
```
ipmitool fru
ipmitool lan print 1
racadm getsel -o
hexdump -C /var/log/bmc-fw-dump.bin | head -n 80
```
leo: I'll coordinate an on-call trip to the colo in 2 hours if we need physical access.
maria: For now marking nodes as unusable. I'll post status updates here. :white_check_mark:
sophia: put an alert in console runbook that 1.3.0 may enforce signed kernels; add rollback playbook.
maria: thanks everyone — will update after TAC reply.
